payload.summary: Planned roadmap item ri-01 of verification-enforcement-discipline: bind every stored merge verdict to head SHA and git patch-id, make the vendor-review predicate total, record waivers explicitly, check reviewer independence, and pin gh pr merge to the reviewed head.
completed_work: proposal.md, design.md (D1-D9), specs/merge-pull-requests/spec.md, tasks.md, contracts/README.md, work-packages.yaml (6 packages); strict openspec, work-packages and parallel-zones validators pass.
Planning lock claims registered for all six package keys.

decisions.title: Approach A: shared verdict_binding module plus total predicate
decisions.rationale: Selected at Gate 1. One currency rule (current/rebased/stale) closes the unbound-verdict, dead-skip, absence-as-pass and self-review gaps, and adjudication can reuse it.

decisions.title: Review waivers live in state, recorded at execute time
decisions.rationale: Correction found during planning: eligibility is computed live by check_review_eligibility, so build_plan cannot write definition.review_waiver. execute_plan records policy waivers from a closed set.

decisions.title: Widen review_dispatcher exclude_vendor to accept a collection
decisions.rationale: dispatch_and_wait re-runs discover_reviewers internally, so author-vendor exclusion cannot be done in vendor_review alone. Shared parallel-infrastructure file; string form unchanged.

decisions.title: Use same_family, not same_family_as_author
decisions.rationale: Matches the field name in add-orchestrator-adjudication-review-gate so both changes share one binding shape.

decisions.title: Operator waiver does not override changes_requested
decisions.rationale: changes_requested is a human reviewer's state, not the merge tool's to waive.

decisions.title: Plan schema 1.1 is rejected, not migrated
decisions.rationale: Plans are short-lived analysis artifacts rebuilt every round; a migration path buys nothing.

next_steps: /implement-feature after ri-02 or in parallel (disjoint scope)
